nos_units.nos_title: Application of Embedded Technology for Mechatronics

pcs.pc_description: • Identify the roles and functions of key hardware • components in embedded systems, such as • microcontrollers, processors, memory, sensors, and • actuators.
• Understand microcontroller architecture and its role in • embedded systems.
• Understand the working principles of peripheral devices • and their integration with embedded systems
• Explain the importance of embedded software and • firmware in controlling hardware components
• Learn the fundamentals of communication protocols like • UART, I2C, SPI, CAN, and wireless protocols (e.g., • Bluetooth, Zigbee).
• Explain how these protocols enable data exchange • between components in an embedded system
• Write, debug, and optimize embedded programs using • low-level programming languages like C
• Use development tools such as IDEs, debuggers, and • simulators to create embedded applications
• Design and implement interfaces between • microcontrollers and external peripherals such as sensors, • actuators, and displays.
• Design scalable and modular embedded systems for • complex applications
Interfacing of sensor, relay, motors to microcontroller
• Test and troubleshoot embedded systems for • performance and reliability
Write and debug embedded programs using C or Python
• Use development tools like IDEs, debuggers, and • emulators for embedded programming.
